Generate ONLY the single word "Sugarfall" with precisely that spelling S-u-g-a-r-f-a-l-l, capital S and all remaining letters lowercase, one line. Match the reference's distinctive large, warm, rounded display-serif letterforms, softly sculpted ivory cream faces, thin warm caramel outline, polished copper bevel and shallow caramel/copper dimensional extrusion underneath. Cream surfaces have gentle warm highlights and tiny material variation. Preserve clear counters and beautiful readable kerning, particularly the g, f and both final ls. Premium illustrated dessert-game lettering, hand-painted polished 3D-like art rather than flat digital type. Horizontal logo composition with all letters fully visible and generous transparent safety padding on every edge. Actual transparent background. No character, no food, no board, no frame, no tagline, no shadow rectangle, no additional text or watermark. assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one full-body transparent PNG animation key pose of the established Sugarfall mascot Mabel. Keep the same warm adult baker with large brown eyes, freckles, chestnut-brown hair in a loose textured bun and the same curl beside her face; mint/sage green collared puff-sleeve dress, ivory apron, small strawberry embroidery at the bib, copper buttons, apron tied in front, two pockets and low brown leather shoes. She has just stopped after running into a scene. She faces the viewer in a relaxed three-quarter pose, smiling and looking directly at us. Her right hand is raised beside her face in a clear friendly hello, palm toward the viewer, five natural fingers comfortably separated; her left arm supports an EMPTY oval ivory plate at waist height. Knees relaxed, weight on one foot; do not make her salute or hold a rigid presentation pose. Full body including both shoes, safe transparent margins, natural painted cutout edges without a white sticker border. Original richly painted storybook/game character rendering, soft warm volumetric light, restrained highlights, matching the references rather than a vector puppet. Truly transparent background; no colored backdrop, text, speech bubble, ground, halo or other person. Plate contains no food, so the later catch sequence can use separate food layers.

assets.name: food-collision-board
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: one isolated transparent PNG food-collision vignette for a Sugarfall trailer end-card. Attached image is the exact material, lighting, game-world and action reference, not an edit target. Generate a compact landscape mint ceramic game tray viewed in the same attractive three-quarter top-down perspective, with a fully visible rounded rectangular polished copper rim. Inside it, a large golden pink-iced sprinkle doughnut is visibly striking a round golden fluted biscuit near left-center, the biscuit sheds a few large readable crumbs and a small warm impact sparkle. At right-center, a pink strawberry ice-cream scoop rebounds against a golden round waffle biscuit with the same small crumb burst. Three or four other intact biscuit pegs sit sparsely in the tray to suggest a physics game, not an overflowing assortment. Two delicate short cream/pink curved motion trails follow the doughnut and scoop paths. Main food large, round and appetizing; two contacts easy to understand at phone size. The doughnut stays a recognizable ring, the icecream scoop is clearly distinct. Same creamy polished hand-painted game-marketing finish, mint glazed ceramic with fine subtle marble veins, golden baked biscuit textures, pink toppings and soft copper gleams as reference. Keep entire tray, trajectories and all crumbs within a generous transparent margin; landscape aspect about3:2. Actual transparent background outside this single tray vignette. No background scene, arches or floor, no text or lettering, no logo, Mabel, button, extra panels, gem balls or coins. No huge starbursts, no debris across the whole picture. The isolated art must layer neatly beneath a separate wordmark and above a separate character.
